boundaries.environment: Results are bound to the local headless Chromium version and host recorded by the test runner; they are not deterministic across machines.
boundaries.deployment: This contract does not measure a deployed origin, CDN, response headers, cache persistence, or end-user network conditions.
boundaries.memory: Chromium JSHeapUsedSize after an explicit DevTools garbage collection is a bounded regression signal, not whole-process or device memory proof. generationAndPreviewUs measures click-to-declared-completion timing; both workloads complete only after an exact retained observation, decoded structural SVG preview, and primary-part customization target discovery have settled with aria-busy=false. Motor completion requires the settled enabled selector to contain two options; Power completion requires the settled disabled selector to contain one placeholder option and display its zero-compatible/no-alternate state.
boundaries.providers: Commercial sourcing providers remain disabled and are not contacted.
boundaries.simulation: No simulation is executed and no selected-part simulation-fidelity claim is made.
